description: Make a link page, or change one: a public page at the app’s address followed by /@handle, with the user’s name, one line about them, their connected accounts as icons and their link buttons. Only what you send changes. The page takes its colours, fonts and logo from the saved brand and keeps the latest posts and the open-now line current by itself, so never add those as links. Starter includes 1 page, Studio 10 and Pro 30; one more is refused. A handle someone else has is refused. With showBlog a page also carries the user’s blog: their articles, at the page’s address followed by /blog.

accountIds.description: The connected accounts this page shows as icons, and whose latest posts it shows, as ids from accounts_list, up to 150. Leave out to keep it as it is; null shows every connected account, which is how a new page starts.

addLink.description: One link to add without sending the whole list. It goes first, under the top button. Use it for "add my new video to my link page".

label.description: The words on the button, up to 60 characters.

top.description: true makes it the top button; the link that was the top button stays as an ordinary link.

url.description: Where it leads: an https:// web address, a tel: phone number or a mailto: email address, up to 500 characters.

bio.description: One line about the business or the person, up to 160 characters. Empty text removes it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

handle.description: The page’s address, after the @: 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example "casa-lola". Needed for a new page. Changing it moves the page: the old address stops working at once. If the page was ever public, the old address stays reserved for the user for 30 days: nobody else can take it, and they can move the page back.

hideBranding.description: true removes the “Made with Spica Post” line and generator tag from this link page, its blog and its media kit (Pro). Verified custom domains are always white-label.

id.description: A page id from links_list, to change that page. Leave out to make a new page.

links.description: Every link button, in the order shown, up to 30. This replaces the list, so send the links from links_list with your change made. To add one link, use addLink.

label.description: The words on the button, up to 60 characters.

shown.description: false keeps the link on the page’s list without showing it. Shown when left out.

top.description: true makes this the top button: drawn first and filled. At most one link.

url.description: Where the button leads: a web address starting with https://, a phone number as tel:+13055550100, or an email address as mailto:name@example.com. Nothing else is accepted, and an address runs to 500 characters at most.

name.description: The name at the top of the page, up to 60 characters. The business name from the brand when left out.

published.description: true puts the page at its public address; false takes it down. A new page is not published until this is true. Ask the user before publishing.

showBlog.description: true makes this the page that carries the user’s blog: the articles put on the blog are public at this page’s address followed by /blog, and the page names the newest three. A workspace has one blog, so the page that had it gives it up and every article’s address changes. Off for a new page.

showHours.description: Whether the page says if the business is open now, from the opening hours on the brand. On for a new page; nothing is shown while the brand has no hours.

showPosts.description: Whether the page shows the latest published posts (up to three). On for a new page.

name: links_save
title: Save a link page
